decision.title:
Decision: approved | denied. (expired/cancelled are state
transitions handled by other paths.)

reason.description: Reason: required when decision=denied; optional on approve.

coOwnerPrincipalIds.description: Replaces the co-owner succession set wholesale.

newOwnerPrincipalId.description: The new owner of record. Must be a current org admin.

clearMask.description:
Paths whose explicit overrides should be removed before applying patch.
A cleared field resolves to its catalog default on the returned document.

patch.description:
Partial — only explicitly present fields change. Missing parent messages
are materialized by the typed settings SDK, and nested siblings survive.

PlatformAdminServiceReplayJobBody.description:
ReplayJobRequest creates a new pending copy of one dead-lettered job. The
source row remains immutable. idempotency_key makes an operator retry resolve
to the same new job instead of duplicating the side effect.

PlatformAdminServiceUpsertFeatureFlagBod.description:
Deprecated: the database-backed flag inventory is read-only while consumers
migrate to the provider-neutral feature-flags@1 capability.

parentTeamId.description: Optional: create as a child of this team (must belong to the same org).

slug.description: Optional: explicit path segment; derived from name when empty.

gracePeriodSeconds.description:
grace_period_seconds — how long the OLD secret stays valid for
signature verification on incoming replays. 0 = revoke
immediately; 86400 (24h) is the recommended default for staged
rollouts. Bound to a 7-day max server-side.

eventType.description:
event_type to queue. Empty defaults to "webhook.test"; otherwise it must
use the same canonical lowercase routing vocabulary as subscriptions. The
payload is server-generated and the generic outbox worker sends it.

label.description: Human-readable boundary name, visible only for caller-accessible scopes.

scopeContractVersion.description: Version 1 acknowledges resource, collection and payload filters, even with no buckets.

count.description:
count is the group's COUNT(*), always populated for back-compat and also
available in metrics under any requested count alias.

key.description: key is the first group dimension's value; keys holds every dimension.

keys.description: keys are the group dimension values, aligned with the effective group_bys.

metrics.description:
metrics maps each requested metric and derived alias to its value. An alias
is omitted for a group where the metric is undefined (min/avg/max/percentile
over zero numeric values) — absence means "no data", not zero.

samples.description:
Number of non-null observations used by each source metric, before
distinct reduction. Less than count means partial telemetry. Missing on
older servers; clients must not assume completeness in that case.

eventType.description:
event_type is the registered discriminator (see the typed audit-event
registry). schema_version records which payload schema the row was written
against; payload is the typed, per-type payload; category groups types.

namespace.description:
The module namespace that owns the type: the leading segment of `name`.
Distinct from `owner`, which names the emitting service.

deviceInfo.description:
Bounded display-only device description (typically the browser user-agent).
It is persisted with the refresh family for session management and is
never trusted as an authentication or authorization signal.

profile.description: Optional signup/profile metadata. OAuth protocol fields do not belong here.

providerId.description:
Deprecated caller-asserted identity fields. Kept only for wire
compatibility during the v0 transition; Authenticate ignores them.

mfaToken.description:
Opaque, short-lived, one-use login transaction. Present only when
mfa_required is true; it is not an access or refresh token.

v1BeginOAuthRequest.description:
BeginOAuthRequest is the FE's first hop on the authorization-code
flow. Server returns a server-signed `state` token bound to
(provider, redirect_uri); the FE embeds it in the provider's
authorize URL alongside its own PKCE code_challenge. Authenticate
later verifies the state before exchanging the code.

state.description:
state is opaque to the FE — pass it back unchanged in the
authorize URL and again in the Authenticate request.

v1BeginWebAuthnMFAChallengeRequest.description:
Begins a WebAuthn assertion for an existing primary-authentication handoff.
The mfa_token remains the login credential; the returned ceremony token is
an independently random, short-lived handle for server-side WebAuthn state.

publicKeyOptionsJson.description:
JSON-encoded PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptions. The browser hands these
generated options directly to the WebAuthn API.
JSON-encoded PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions generated by the server.

readGrants.description: Active documents/read grants at this node or an ancestor.

v1CompleteMFAChallengeRequest.description:
CompleteMFAChallengeRequest is deliberately distinct from VerifyTOTPRequest:
this completes a login transaction, while VerifyTOTP only confirms a new
authenticator during enrollment.

code.description: Six-digit TOTP or a one-use backup code.

credentialResponseJson.description: JSON-encoded PublicKeyCredential assertion returned by the browser.

allowedAudiences.description:
Optional delegated-execution ceiling. allowed_audiences bounds the Work
Context audiences this agent may be minted for; allowed_scopes bounds the
resource kinds it may request. Empty = unrestricted (rollout default).

v1DelegationEvent.description:
DelegationEvent is one streaming event delivered to a
subscriber. The agent SDK reads exactly one event (the
terminal decision) and disconnects.

mintedTokenId.description:
On approve: the unique id of the minted token (for audit
correlation). Same value as the encoded token's `id` field.

scopedAuthToken.description:
On approve: the gateway's freshly minted scoped-auth token.
Empty on deny / expired / cancelled.

v1EventRelayHealth.description:
EventRelayHealth is the outbox-drain view across every type: how far the relay
is behind, expressed as a backlog count and a head-of-line age.

backlog.description: backlog is the number still awaiting fan-out (published_at IS NULL).

oldestUnpublishedAt.description:
oldest_unpublished_at is the created_at of the oldest unpublished event —
the head-of-line relay lag. Unset when the backlog is empty.

publishedEvents.description: published_events is the number the relay has fanned out (published_at set).

v1EventSubscriptionSummary.description:
EventSubscriptionSummary is one live (non-revoked) control-plane subscription
resolved by the relay for fan-out.

queue.description: queue is the inbox queue the relay enqueues deliveries onto.

queueDeadLetter.description:
queue_dead_letter is the number of dead-lettered deliveries currently on
this subscription's queue (shared across subscriptions on the same queue).

subscriberPrincipalId.description: subscriber_principal_id is the principal that receives the delivery.

typePattern.description: type_pattern is an exact type or a single trailing ".*" wildcard.

v1EventTypeSnapshot.description:
EventTypeSnapshot is one published event type: its declared catalog contract
joined with live counters drawn from domain_events. A catalog type with no
rows yet still appears, with zero counters.

lastEventAt.description: last_event_at is the newest created_at across rows of this type, if any.

major.description: major is the schema major version from the catalog.

publisher.description: publisher is the owning namespace (the leading dotted segment of type).

subscribers.description: subscribers is the count of live subscriptions whose pattern matches type.

totalEvents.description: total_events is the number of domain_events rows of this type.

type.description: type is the fully-qualified event type, e.g. "reference.console.viewed".

unpublished.description: unpublished is the number not yet fanned out (published_at IS NULL).

visibility.description:
visibility is the declared catalog visibility: internal | tenant | external.
Internal types are intra-platform and never delivered to a subscriber.

v1ExchangeWorkContextAudienceRequest.description:
ExchangeWorkContextAudienceRequest reissues the same immutable Task,
Session, owner, and delegation lineage for another service boundary while
attenuating the effective authority to the requested scopes.

token.description:
Opaque token looked up in the explicitly selected development fixture.
It is not a provider subject and is never trusted without the fixture
validator.

v1FollowResourceRequest.description:
FollowResourceRequest deliberately carries no subject field. The follower is
always the authenticated caller, so the RPC can never be turned into an oracle
about another principal — the same reason ListMyAccessibleScopesRequest omits
one. A target the caller cannot currently see is reported as missing, never as
denied, so Follow cannot be used to probe for resources that exist elsewhere.

deadLetters.description:
dead_letters is the per-queue dead-letter count over live subscriber queues,
ordered by queue. Empty when no event delivery is dead-lettered.

eventTypes.description:
event_types is every published catalog type with its live counters,
ordered by type.

observedAt.description: observed_at is the database clock at which the snapshot was taken.

relay.description: relay is the platform-wide outbox drain health.

health.description: Resolved live at read time from current authority facts.

limit.description:
limit is -1 when the meter is unlimited, 0 when disabled, or positive for
a hard cap.

token.description:
Signed JWT copied verbatim by the login route from the gateway-injected
identity header. It is verified against the configured JWKS (or, under an
explicit perimeter-trust decode mode, decoded with exp/aud still enforced)
before any claim is trusted.

agentIdentifier.description:
Canonical "publisher/name:version" of the solution's agent. The agent
Principal is created idempotently per version.

allowedAudiences.description:
The agent's delegated-execution ceiling (migration 108): the Work Context
audiences it may be minted for and the resource kinds it may ever touch.
Empty = unrestricted.

coOwnerPrincipalIds.description:
Succession set: any one being a current org admin keeps the installation
healthy. Each must be a human principal.

displayName.description: Human display name for the agent principal. Empty defaults to the identifier.

ownerPrincipalId.description:
The accountable human of record. Must be a current org admin. Empty defaults
to the calling admin.

roleId.description:
The least-privilege role granted to the agent at the root node. This is
deliberately NOT the full "<namespace>:catalog" role; widening is a separate,
audited admin action.

rootScopeLabel.description:
Human-readable display label for the solution's authority-root scope node
(kind='solution'). The node's ltree path is derived server-side, not this.

v1Installation.description:
Installation is one solution's bound identity in an org. Server-assigned ids;
the browser cannot attest to tenancy, the agent principal, or the scope node.

v1InstallationHealth.description:
InstallationHealth is resolved live from current authority facts, never
stored. It is the observable form of the fail-closed mint rule: a
StartInstallationTask fails exactly when health is not HEALTHY, and transfer
or re-enable restores it. NO_ELIGIBLE_OWNER means neither the owner of record
nor any co-owner is currently an org admin (the Zapier-class "connection owner
left the org" failure), surfaced rather than silently reassigned.

v1InstallationStatus.description:
InstallationStatus is the lifecycle of an installation row. An uninstall is a
soft delete (status=revoked, revoked_at set) so the agent, grants, and audit
trail remain resolvable.

v1Invoice.description:
Invoice — trimmed view of Stripe's invoice object. Amounts are in
the smallest currency unit (cents for USD/EUR); FE divides by 100.

v1IssuedWorkContext.description:
IssuedWorkContext is the opaque signed capability plus safe correlation
fields useful to an SDK caller. Consumers must verify the token rather than
trusting these duplicated display fields.

v1JobAttempt.description:
JobAttempt is the immutable result of one lease. The attempt row is opened
when a job is claimed and finalized once; heartbeats may update heartbeat_at
while it remains open.

v1JobAttemptOutcome.description: JobAttemptOutcome records why one processing lease ended.

v1JobDirection.description:
JobDirection distinguishes work accepted from an external producer from work
emitted transactionally for an external consumer.

v1JobEnqueueDisposition.description:
JobEnqueueDisposition distinguishes a newly committed message from an exact
idempotent replay that resolved to the message already stored.

v1JobFailure.description:
JobFailure contains bounded operator-safe diagnostics. It must never contain
credentials or the original payload.

v1JobLease.description:
JobLease is present only while a job is processing. token is an unguessable
fencing value: finalization must match both owner and token.

v1JobQueueSnapshot.description:
JobQueueSnapshot is database-derived operational state and is therefore
consistent across replicas. Queue is the only metric label; topic, tenant,
subject, source, job id, and error text remain out of the metric surface.

v1JobScope.description:
JobScope carries the tenant or subject binding enforced when request traffic
appends a job. Global scope is reserved for the privileged worker boundary.

v1JobState.description:
JobState is the durable message lifecycle. New jobs start pending. Processing
owns a lease. Retrying becomes claimable at available_at. The remaining
states are terminal; replay creates a new job linked to the original rather
than rewriting terminal history.

v1JobStateTransition.description:
JobStateTransition is the append-only audit record produced by the database
whenever a job is created or changes state.

v1JobSummary.description:
JobSummary is the payload-free operations view. Payload bytes and attributes
never cross the platform-administration API boundary.

v1ListAccessibleScopesResponse.description:
Shared by the caller-scoped ListMyAccessibleScopes below AND by the internal
PermissionService.ListAccessibleScopes in authorization.proto. It lives in this
file, so it ships to every published SDK consumer: a field added here for the
internal RPC's benefit widens the public surface too. Add internal-only detail
to a message in authorization.proto instead.

nextPageToken.description: Set when more scopes remain; pass it back as page_token. Empty on the last page.

subscriptions.description:
subscriptions is every live subscription across all principals, ordered by
created_at.

returnUrl.description:
Deprecated: redirect policy is server-owned and this value is ignored.
Retain the field until the next major API version so v0.0.2 clients remain
source-compatible as well as wire-compatible.

organizationId.title: WorkOS Organization id (the customer's tenant on WorkOS)

v1OrgSSOConfig.title:
OrgSSOConfig is the per-org SSO state. Empty connection_id means
SSO is not configured. status mirrors WorkOS Connections lifecycle:
  ""             — not configured
  "linked"       — admin portal link issued, IdP setup pending
  "active"       — connection live; email-domain users SSO-routed
  "disabled"     — connection exists but admin paused it

v1OrganizationSettings.description:
OrganizationSettings is the org analogue of UserSettings
(user_settings.proto): a generic, typed, JSONB-backed preferences blob whose
product-contributed fields are generated into the composed container. Storage
keeps sparse ProtoJSON; the API recursively merges typed protobuf patches and
resolves catalog defaults on read. It is distinct from OrgSettings above,
which remains the fixed-column branding surface.

composed.description:
Product-contributed org settings are generated into this typed container.
ProtoJSON storage and API patching preserve the same schema end to end.

v1PermissionInfo.description: PermissionInfo — RBAC vocabulary this service enforces.

v1Principal.description:
Principal mirrors the principals table 1:1 — the unified identity
row used by every action, audit event, and delegation grant.

id matches users.uuid for kind=HUMAN, api_keys.id for kind=SERVICE,
and is a fresh server-generated UUID for kind=AGENT. We do NOT
enforce these as foreign keys at the DB level (independent
lifecycles); the equality is convention and the backfill migration.

agentIdentifier.description:
agent_identifier is "publisher/name:version" for kind=AGENT;
empty otherwise. Required when kind=AGENT.

allowedAudiences.description:
For kind=AGENT only: the delegated-execution ceiling declared at
registration. allowed_audiences bounds the Work Context audiences this
actor may be minted for; allowed_scopes bounds the resource kinds it may
request. Empty = unrestricted.

createdBy.description:
The principal that created this one — the authorship root a policy
consumer chains authority back to. Empty = a root principal (humans).

disabledAt.description:
A reversible suspension of a delegated actor, distinct from the terminal
revoked_at. While set the actor resolves as inactive, so outstanding Work
Contexts go stale on the authorization-revision bump and no new one mints.

orgId.description:
org_id NULL/empty for kind=HUMAN (cross-org); required for
SERVICE and AGENT. Server-side validation enforces.

v1PrincipalKind.description:
PrincipalKind classifies a principal — humans, services, or agents
— for filtering/UI without affecting authorization. The auth layer
itself treats every Principal uniformly. ANY change here MUST stay
in sync with the SQL CHECK constraint on principals.kind and with
codefly's policy.Principal Kind constants.

v1QueueDeadLetters.description:
QueueDeadLetters counts exhausted event deliveries currently sitting in the
dead-letter state on one subscriber queue.

v1RLSPolicyInfo.description:
RLSPolicyInfo — RLS-protected table this service depends on (the
table itself lives in the store service's schema, but this api
service is the enforcer).

v1RPCInfo.description: RPCInfo — one entry per gRPC RPC this service exposes.

scopes.title: required scopes when called via API key

resourceType.description:
Set both to place a product record at this node; leave both empty for a
structural node.

scopePath.description:
scope_path must be UNIQUE within the org and its immediate parent must
already be registered (roots — a single label — have no parent). A placed
record is a leaf: give each record its own distinct path, e.g.
"foundation.customer_7.doc_<encoded_id>", not the shared container path —
two records at the same path collide on the uniqueness constraint.

v1RenewWorkContextRequest.description:
RenewWorkContextRequest extends an in-flight delegated capability past the
signing TTL cap without the originating user present. The caller is the
current (outermost) actor of the parent context, not its owner, so a
long-running delegated task can keep itself alive. Renewal preserves the
Task, Session, owner, and delegation lineage; it may attenuate but can never
widen the current actor's authority.

attenuatedScopes.description:
Optional narrowed scopes. Empty keeps the current actor's effective
authority unchanged; when present they must attenuate it.

audience.description:
Optional new audience. Empty keeps the parent context's audience, the
common renewal case where only the TTL is refreshed.

grantor.description:
Grantor: optional explicit target ("user:<id>" / "team:<name>");
empty → default approver chain.

justification.description:
Justification — REQUIRED. Without it the grantor has no
basis to decide; saas-starter rejects empty/whitespace.

requestHash.description: Idempotency key. Server derives from request content if empty.

riskLevel.description: risk_level: low|medium|high|critical. Empty defaults to low.

timeoutSeconds.description:
timeout_seconds: how long to wait before auto-expiry.
Defaults to 300 (5 min) if zero.

status.title: typically "pending"; may be "approved" if a pattern matches (M8)

secret.description:
The new signing secret, returned ONCE on rotation. Show + copy
in the FE; not retrievable again.

v1ScopeInfo.description: ScopeInfo — API-key scope this service accepts.

resourceType.description:
resource_type/resource_id are set when the node is a placed record (a
leaf identifying a real product row); empty for structural nodes.

scopePath.description:
scope_path is a dotted ltree path of [a-z0-9_] labels, e.g.
"foundation.solution_42.customer_7". UUIDs are encoded (lowercase,
'-' -> '_') because raw UUIDs are not valid ltree labels.

v1ServiceCapabilities.description: ServiceCapabilities — the full self-description of one service.

v1ServiceInfo.description:
ServiceInfo — top-level identity of the service this catalog
describes. The `module` field locates this service within its
codefly module so an aggregator can group across services.

version.title: semver of the service's API surface

id.description:
Stable refresh-family identifier for one device login. Unlike the JWT sid,
it does not change when the refresh token rotates.

v1StartSSOSetupRequest.description:
StartSSOSetupRequest kicks off the admin portal flow. The backend
(a) ensures a WorkOS Organization exists for the saas-starter org,
(b) mints a portal link, (c) returns it for browser redirect.

returnUrl.description:
return_url is where WorkOS redirects the admin after they
finish IdP setup. Typically the saas-starter /admin/sso page.

portalLink.description:
portal_link is the one-shot URL the FE redirects the browser
to. Expires per WorkOS policy (15 min default). Re-callable to
mint a fresh one if the operator needs to re-enter the portal.

actorPrincipalId.description:
Empty means a direct human-owned Task. Otherwise this must name an active,
registered agent Principal in org_id.

workspaceId.description:
Optional Codefly execution boundary. When set, consumers bind the
capability to this exact workspace and reject cross-workspace reuse.

v1SubjectKind.description:
- SUBJECT_KIND_PRINCIPAL: A direct role assignment always targets a Principal. Human users remain
Principals of kind HUMAN; agents and services can receive the same
explicitly assigned authority without masquerading as users.
 - SUBJECT_KIND_USER: Backward-compatible wire/JSON input alias. New clients must use
SUBJECT_KIND_PRINCIPAL.

organizationId.description:
Target tenant for this existing device session. The server resolves the
caller's current membership and role; no role is accepted from the client.

accessToken.description:
Fresh access token for organization_id. The refresh token and device
family do not rotate, so switching cannot race with normal refresh-token
reuse detection or create an extra active device.

v1Team.description:
Teams form a strict tree within an org: parent_team_id is the authoritative
edge; path is the materialized slug-path ("engineering/platform"), unique per
org, maintained on write. Membership is literal (you belong to the teams you
joined); consumers that want subtree semantics expand the path (a member of
"engineering/platform" is, by expansion, under "engineering").

path.description: Full slug-path from the root, e.g. "engineering/platform". Server-derived.

slug.description: The team's own path segment: lowercase slug, derived from name if not given.

clearMask.description:
Paths whose explicit overrides should be removed before applying patch.
A cleared field resolves to its catalog default on the returned document.

patch.description:
Partial — only explicitly present fields change. Missing parent messages
are materialized by the typed settings SDK, and nested siblings survive.

v1UpsertFeatureFlagResponse.description: Deprecated: UpsertFeatureFlag always fails closed and returns no response.

v1User.title: User represents a user in the system

v1UserAppearanceSettings.description:
UserAppearanceSettings — presentation preferences shared by every Starter
frontend. The setting describes user intent, not a specific web client, so
native and future clients consume the same value.

v1UserEmailSettings.description:
UserEmailSettings — top-level transactional email opt-ins.
`security` is forced-on server-side but exposed here so the
unsubscribe page can reflect that to the user.

v1UserIdentity.title: UserIdentity represents a user's authentication method

v1UserRegionalSettings.description:
UserRegionalSettings — locale and formatting preferences shared by all
clients and backend-rendered content.

v1UserSettings.description:
UserSettings — common per-user preferences included in every SaaS Starter.
All scalar fields below the section messages are optional so an explicit
false/empty value remains distinct from an unset value that resolves to its
catalog default. The API recursively merges typed protobuf patches.

composed.description:
Product-contributed settings are generated into this typed container.
ProtoJSON storage and API patching preserve the same schema end to end.

eventId.description:
Stable across endpoint fan-out and manual replay; use with the signed
timestamp to reject replayed events idempotently.

responseBody.description:
response_body — captured upstream response (truncated server-side
to 4KiB). Empty when the request never connected.

secret.description:
Generated by the server and returned only by CreateSubscription. List and
all later reads leave this empty; store it in the consumer immediately.

v1WorkContextReplayPolicy.description:
WorkContextReplayPolicy controls how a consumer may accept a signed Work
Context. Single-use still requires a durable replay store at the consumer.

v1WorkContextScope.description:
WorkContextScope is one product-neutral authority slice. Product plugins
contribute the resource/action vocabulary through Accounts RBAC; this API
does not carry a built-in list of product permissions.

parameters.description: Page bound, same ceiling as the internal RPC.
parameters.name: pageSize

parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's next_page_token; empty for page one.
parameters.name: pageToken

get.summary:
ListMyAccessibleScopes is the authenticated, caller-scoped companion to the
internal PermissionService.ListAccessibleScopes: a signed-in org member
enumerates the scope nodes THEY may act on with (resource_type, action)
through the gateway with a normal bearer. The subject is the bearer's own
principal — no subject_id in the request — so it can never be an oracle
about other principals. Same grant + share union and same pagination as the
internal RPC.

parameters.description:
The owning org — lets the handler enforce org-admin (not platform-admin)
revocation. Maps to a query param on the REST DELETE.
parameters.name: organizationId

parameters.description: use event_type
parameters.name: action

parameters.description:
payload_contains is a JSONB containment filter: every key/value must match
the event's payload.
parameters.name: payloadContains

parameters.description:
namespace scopes the search to the module that minted the event types, e.g.
"saas". A composed workspace carries one namespace per emitting module.
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.description:
group_by ∈ {event_type, category, actor, time, payload:<key>}. Defaults to
event_type. Superseded by group_bys when that is set.
parameters.name: groupBy

parameters.description: bucket sizes the time grain for a "time" dimension: day|week|month.
parameters.name: bucket

parameters.description:
group_bys lists group dimensions for multi-dimensional grouping. When set it
supersedes group_by; each entry is one of the group_by values above.
parameters.name: groupBys

parameters.description:
namespace scopes the aggregation to one module's event types, matching
QueryAuditLogRequest.namespace.
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.description:
Exact registered resource boundary. Requires org_id, resource, event_type
and current read access to this resource in addition to audit:read.
parameters.name: resourceId

parameters.description:
String-valued JSONB containment, ANDed with every other filter. A
`boundary` key on a registered saas.document.* event names a collection, so
it carries the same current-read requirement as collection_id below rather
than being a way to spell that filter without the check.
parameters.name: payloadContains

parameters.description:
Document event collection: current documents/read authorization plus an
exact payload.boundary predicate. Requires a registered saas.document.*
event with a boundary field; never a caller-supplied grant.
parameters.name: collectionId

parameters.description:
CompleteMFAChallengeRequest is deliberately distinct from VerifyTOTPRequest:
this completes a login transaction, while VerifyTOTP only confirms a new
authenticator during enrollment.
parameters.name: body

post.summary:
Public RPC: possession of the opaque mfa_token is the temporary login
credential. Successful verification atomically consumes it and creates
the normal refreshable session.

parameters.description:
Begins a WebAuthn assertion for an existing primary-authentication handoff.
The mfa_token remains the login credential; the returned ceremony token is
an independently random, short-lived handle for server-side WebAuthn state.
parameters.name: body

post.summary:
Public RPCs: possession of the opaque mfa_token gates both operations.
Finish atomically consumes both the WebAuthn ceremony and login handoff.

parameters.description:
BeginOAuthRequest is the FE's first hop on the authorization-code
flow. Server returns a server-signed `state` token bound to
(provider, redirect_uri); the FE embeds it in the provider's
authorize URL alongside its own PKCE code_challenge. Authenticate
later verifies the state before exchanging the code.
parameters.name: body

post.summary:
BeginOAuth issues a server-signed `state` for the OAuth code flow.
Public RPC: callable without authentication (this is the start of
the login flow).

Exchanges the authenticated access-token context for another organization
in the same device family. Membership and current role are resolved under
the locked session row before the selected organization is persisted.

parameters.description: 0 → server default (12)
parameters.name: limit

post.summary:
RequestDelegation creates a new pending grant. Idempotent on
(org_id, request_hash) — same request from a retrying actor
returns the original row's id.

DecideDelegation is the grantor's approve/deny action. Called
from the approval UI; transitions the row + (on approve)
mints the scoped-auth token + fires NOTIFY for any waiting
streams.

get.summary:
WaitForDelegation streams one terminal event for a grant.
Backed by Postgres LISTEN — no polling.

ListPendingDelegations returns paginated pending grants for
the approver UI. Sorted critical → high → medium → low,
newest-first within tier.

post.summary:
InstallSolution composes an installation in one transaction: an idempotent
agent Principal with its ceiling, a solution scope node, the agent's standing
least-privilege grant at that node, and the installation row with its owner of
record. Emits installation.created with the grantor and ceiling.

get.summary:
GetInstallation returns one installation plus its live health, so an admin UI
can see when an installation has gone unhealthy (owner offboarded, agent
disabled, grant expired) before the next headless task fails closed.

post.summary:
TransferInstallationOwnership reassigns the owner of record and replaces the
co-owner succession set. This is how a "connection owner left the org"
failure is repaired: an admin transfers the installation to a current admin,
restoring its health.

UninstallSolution reverses an install: it revokes the agent principal, removes
its standing grant, and marks the installation revoked. The solution scope node
is left in place (inert without a grant or a live agent) so a reinstall reuses
it. Idempotent on an already-revoked installation.

get.summary:
Generic org settings — the org analogue of UserSettingsService. Whole typed
message in, whole resolved message out; adding an org setting is proto +
regen only, with no endpoint change. Reads require org membership; writes
require org admin, mirroring the branding surface above.

GetUsage returns the caller organization's current UTC month for one
meter. Cardinality quotas such as seats remain entitlement gauges rather
than usage events.

Domain-event platform operations (#494 P3). Payload bytes never leave the
durable event boundary through these methods — only counts, timings, and
control-plane subscription metadata do.

Queue the existing delivery's exact payload for its subscription's current
URL and secret. The result is a NEW pending delivery row; the original row
is unchanged and the generic outbox worker owns execution.
parameters.name: id

parameters.description:
ExchangeWorkContextAudienceRequest reissues the same immutable Task,
Session, owner, and delegation lineage for another service boundary while
attenuating the effective authority to the requested scopes.
parameters.name: body

post.summary:
ExchangeAudience derives a least-privilege, audience-bound capability
without changing the Task, Session, owner, or delegation identity.

parameters.description:
RenewWorkContextRequest extends an in-flight delegated capability past the
signing TTL cap without the originating user present. The caller is the
current (outermost) actor of the parent context, not its owner, so a
long-running delegated task can keep itself alive. Renewal preserves the
Task, Session, owner, and delegation lineage; it may attenuate but can never
widen the current actor's authority.
parameters.name: body

post.summary:
RenewWorkContext is the actor-authorized exchange path. Unlike the
owner-bound RPCs, the caller is the current actor of the parent context,
letting a delegated task extend its own authority past the TTL cap while
the originating user is offline. Renewal re-resolves current authority and
fails closed on a stale revision or a revoked chain hop, and can only
attenuate the actor's scopes.
